The '''Markaran Wastes''', also known as '''Spire Swamp''', was an area in the northern [[Markaran Plains]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] that became a toxic swamp after the [[Camp Traken-4|Traken-4 ChemWorks]] plant on the area's northern edge was damaged during the [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|Battle of Balmorra]]. It became a [[Balmorran resistance]] stronghold, with the [[Gold Neebray]] faction holding the area until the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] overran the area and took the ruins of Traken-4 for themselves.
